verdict.rationale: Natural-language control is a fair question for a GPU product, since its companion control software could ship a conversational assistant. The evidence shows no such feature. Running LLMs on the card via vLLM or Llama.cpp is a workload the GPU executes, not a way to operate the GPU. HYPR-RX one-click profiles and the AMD Software home tab are adjacent UI controls, not natural-language commands.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
